name: Netflow Traffic Analysis
description: Traffic analysis — direction, provider, protocol breakdowns, top talkers, ports, countries, and conversations.

0.content:
# Netflow Traffic Analysis
What is my network doing right now? Direction breakdown, provider/ASN enrichment, protocol mix, and top talkers at a glance.
**Use case:** "How much traffic is inbound vs outbound? Which cloud providers am I talking to most? Who are my top talkers?"

1.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| summarize total_bytes = sum(toLong(coalesce(`netflow.flow.io.bytes`, 0)))
| fieldsAdd total_gb = round(total_bytes / 1073741824.0, decimals: 2)
1.title: Total Traffic

10.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| summarize bytes = sum(toLong(coalesce(`netflow.flow.io.bytes`, 0))), by: {protocol = coalesce(`netflow.network.transport`, "unknown")}
| sort bytes desc
10.title: Protocol Distribution

11.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| summarize bytes = sum(toLong(coalesce(`netflow.flow.io.bytes`, 0))), by: {provider = coalesce(`netflow.destination.provider`, `netflow.source.provider`, "unenriched")}
| filter provider != "private"
| sort bytes desc
| limit 15
11.title: Top Providers by Traffic

12.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| summarize bytes = sum(toLong(coalesce(`netflow.flow.io.bytes`, 0))), flow_count = count(), by: {port = coalesce(`netflow.destination.port`, "unknown")}
| sort bytes desc
| limit 10
12.title: Top 10 Ports

13.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| summarize bytes = sum(toLong(coalesce(`netflow.flow.io.bytes`, 0))), flow_count = count(), by: {country = coalesce(`netflow.destination.country`, "unknown")}
| sort bytes desc
| limit 10
13.title: Top Countries by Traffic

14.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| fieldsAdd src_name = if(isNotNull(`netflow.source.hostname`), then: `netflow.source.hostname`, else: `netflow.source.ip`)
| fieldsAdd dst_name = if(isNotNull(`netflow.destination.hostname`), then: `netflow.destination.hostname`, else: `netflow.destination.ip`)
| fieldsAdd conversation = concat(src_name, " → ", dst_name, " [", coalesce(`netflow.network.transport`, "?"), "/", coalesce(`netflow.flow.direction`, "?"), "]")
| summarize bytes = sum(toLong(coalesce(`netflow.flow.io.bytes`, 0))), flows = count(), by: {conversation, provider = coalesce(`netflow.destination.provider`, "private"), country = coalesce(`netflow.destination.country`, "")}
| sort bytes desc
| limit 50
14.title: Top 50 Conversations (Source → Destination with Enrichment)

2.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| summarize flow_count = count()
2.title: Total Flows

3.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| summarize unique_hosts = countDistinct(coalesce(`netflow.source.ip`, `netflow.destination.ip`))
3.title: Unique Hosts Seen

4.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| summarize unique_svcs = countDistinct(coalesce(`netflow.destination.port`, ""))
4.title: Unique Services

5.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| summarize total = count(), unknown_direction = countIf(coalesce(`netflow.flow.direction`, "unknown") == "unknown")
| fieldsAdd unknown_pct = if(total == 0, then: 0.0, else: round(100.0 * unknown_direction / total, decimals: 1))
5.title: Unknown Direction %

6.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| makeTimeseries bytes = sum(toLong(coalesce(`netflow.flow.io.bytes`, 0))), by: {direction = coalesce(`netflow.flow.direction`, "unknown")}, interval: 5m
6.title: Traffic by Direction Over Time

7.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| filter isNotNull(`netflow.destination.provider`) and `netflow.destination.provider` != "private"
| makeTimeseries bytes = sum(toLong(coalesce(`netflow.flow.io.bytes`, 0))), by: {provider = `netflow.destination.provider`}, interval: 5m
7.title: Traffic by Provider Over Time (Enrichment)

8.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| makeTimeseries bytes = sum(toLong(coalesce(`netflow.flow.io.bytes`, 0))), by: {protocol = coalesce(`netflow.network.transport`, "unknown")}, interval: 5m
8.title: Traffic by Protocol Over Time

9.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| summarize bytes = sum(toLong(coalesce(`netflow.flow.io.bytes`, 0))), by: {direction = coalesce(`netflow.flow.direction`, "unknown")}
| sort bytes desc
9.title: Direction Distribution
